description: Replaced generator-based `any(all(...))` free-text clause evaluation with explicit loops to reduce generator and callback overhead in the hot path.

asi.hypothesis: Generator nesting and callback dispatch in `_matches_free_text_clauses` adds measurable overhead across hundreds of students; explicit loops should be cheaper.
asi.impact: total_ms improved 65.83 -> 64.66 and free_text_ms dropped to 62.89 with unchanged result counts.
asi.safety: Matching semantics unchanged; only iteration/control-flow form changed.
asi.next_action_hint: Try reducing per-term scorer call overhead next (e.g., avoid repeated global lookups or simplify term-matching function dispatch).

name: Optimize DB querying/schema performance and reduce repository duplication
